title: English for Speakers of Other Languages: High Intermediate
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: English for Speakers of Other Languages: High Intermediate - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Participate in campus and classroom culture at a level required for success in intermediate ESOL courses
Apply active reading strategies in order to comprehend, critically analyze and explain ideas in high intermediate level ESOL texts.
Communicate fluently, accurately and appropriately in spoken American English at a level required in high intermediate ESOL courses.
Satisfy high intermediate ESOL standards for clear, effective, well-organized, well-developed, well-edited and logically-sound sentences, paragraphs and essays, and appropriate citation of sources.

notes: The description says the certificate verifies completion of 16 units, including 'two units of other high intermediate or advanced ESOL courses or any college level work conducted in English', but the requirements table prints 'Total Units: 14.00' and lists no such 2-unit elective. total_units records the printed table total of 14. The 2 elective units are not recorded in open_elective_units because the printed 14-unit total does not count them. A reviewer should check which total is correct.
The Career Opportunities text names no specific career or occupation. It mentions only preparation for vocational programs and job advancement, so careers is empty.
ESOL 263A, ESOL 263B, ESOL 050A and ESOL 050B are printed as OR alternatives for the 4-unit listening and speaking requirement. They are recorded as one entry with alternatives.
